title: Black Canyon Ultras 2027 — ITRA race pages (100K and 50K)
publisher: ITRA (International Trail Running Association), data submitted by the organiser
claims: The ITRA 2027 100K page lists 99.90 km, +1,610 m, -2,260 m, a 20-hour limit, 8 aid stations, 1,000 participants and a 07:00 start on 13 February 2027, flagged as a Western States Golden Ticket race.
The ITRA 2027 50K page lists 52.02 km, +531 m, -1,141 m, an 11-hour limit, 0 aid stations, 1,200 participants and a 07:00 start on 14 February 2027.
The ITRA 100K figures disagree with the organiser's 62.2 miles, +5,219 ft and nine-aid-station table.
The ITRA 50K entry of 0 aid stations also disagrees with the organiser's aid-station table.
The ITRA 2027 pages give the venue as Mayer, United States, and list both distances as solo participation.
